influences.name: Young Spanish flamenco guitar player
influences.context: Cohen recalls visiting his mother in Montreal and happening upon a young Spanish flamenco guitar player. He convinced the guitarist to give him lessons, and the young man showed up at Cohen's home for three consecutive days. For three days they worked on the same six-chord progression... the six chords he was taught that summer went on to be the foundation of all of his songs.
